0022600184.text: The Spurs (4-2, on a four-game win streak with a 2-2 home record) host the Dallas Mavericks (4-2, on a three-game streak) in San Antonio's eighth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Spurs sitting 3rd in the Southwest, 2 games back, and Dallas 4th in the Southwest, also 2 games back. San Antonio leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-106 win in Dallas on October 24, and the Spurs won last season's series 4-0. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Max Christie (hip) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision.
